desc: Derive and verify the gap-reversal invariant: operation on pieces i..i+3 reverses gaps g_i, g_{i+1}, g_{i+2}; parity classes of gap indices are invariant and fully permutable within each class (operation at i swaps g_i and g_{i+2}, fixing g_{i+1}).
Prove the rearrangement formula: total sum = N * x_1 + sum_{j=1}^{N-1} (N - j) * g_j; minimizing means sorting each parity class so larger gaps go to larger indices j (smaller weights).
Implement: read N and sorted X, compute gaps, split by index parity, sort each class descending, reassign to positions of that parity in decreasing index order (largest gap to smallest weight).
Compute the answer with Python ints and print.
Verify against samples (21 and 41) — both match by manual computation of the algorithm.
